answer_1.quote: We manually annotate the "win/tie/lose" outcomes of responses from ChatGPT and Vicuna-13B in the Vicuna benchmark, encompassing 80 questions spanning 9 distinct question categories.
answer_1.outputs: Textual assistant responses to user questions

answer_3.quote: We prompt GPT-4 to score and compare candidate responses and provide explanations... we adopt GPT-4 and ChatGPT as evaluators to analyze the characteristics of positional bias in LLM evaluators.

answer_4.quote: Three of the authors manually annotate the "win/tie/lose" outcomes of responses from Chat-GPT and Vicuna-13B independently... the annotators are instructed to assess the responses ... from four different perspectives: helpfulness, relevance, accuracy, and level of detail.
answer_4.guideline: Assess each response on helpfulness, relevance, accuracy, and level of detail; randomize order of responses; use majority voting among three annotators.
